subject.en: Right-facing indigo raven with an angular beak and cyan, mint, and violet feather facets
subject.zh: 向右侧望的靛蓝色渡鸦，棱角分明的鸟喙与青绿、紫色羽毛切面

title.en: A profile that enters the frame

description.en: The long projecting beak balances the rear feather mass. The neck enters naturally from the left and lower edges, while the crown, eye, and beak keep a clear rounded-square margin.
description.zh: 向前伸出的长喙平衡脑后的羽毛，颈部从左侧和下方自然进入画面。头顶、眼睛与鸟喙均留在清晰的圆角安全边界内。

description.en: Broad indigo planes retain the original profile, with cyan, mint, and violet flashes across the feathers. The faceted eye remains the focal point; the existing projecting beak supplies the outward gesture.
description.zh: 大块靛蓝切面保留原有侧脸，青蓝、薄荷绿与紫色穿插在羽毛之间。切面的眼睛保持视觉重心，原有长喙延续向外伸展的姿态。

description.en: Offset angular feather vanes cross a cool dusk-blue field. Their quiet relief and soft shadow give the dark portrait separation without adding another object to the mark.
description.zh: 错落的折羽纹横过冷调暮蓝底面。安静的浅浮雕和柔和阴影为深色头像留出层次，保留原有图形的简洁。

sizeNote.en: At 32 px, the long beak and indigo-cyan feather planes remain readable. At 16 px, the eye facets and smaller feather divisions merge into the profile.
sizeNote.zh: 在 32 px 下，长喙与靛蓝、青色羽毛仍然清楚。缩到 16 px 时，眼睛的细切面与较小的羽毛分区会合并进侧脸轮廓。
